title: TSM BESS / Gigafactory: Governed Energy-Storage Incident Intelligence
_note: Scripted scenario: engine outputs are canned via tests/e2e/helpers/stub-war-room.js, not live model output. Captions are DRAFTS. Narration lines are DRAFTS too: spoken text for --narrate, numbers written as words.

states.caption: BESS / Gigafactory war room
states.narration: This is the battery storage war room, built for energy storage sites and gigafactories. What follows is a simulated incident.

states.caption: BESS incident report loaded
states.narration: An off-gas alarm in Container Seven is escalating toward a thermal event. The operator loads the incident report.

states.caption: Six engines complete: risk scored 71/100
states.narration: Six engines analyze it together. Two of twelve containers are affected, and seventeen percent of site output is offline. The planning estimate is four hundred thousand to six hundred thousand dollars. The risk score is seventy-one out of one hundred.

states.caption: Operations Strategist receives the BESS relay
states.narration: The case moves to the Operations Strategist in one click. It carries the full analysis, and projects the exposure if the site acts now, or does not.

states.caption: Executive Portal with the BESS relay
states.narration: In the Executive Portal, one decision is waiting: isolate Container Seven and suspend charging within two hours. The recommendation comes from the system. The authorization comes from a person.
